findings.text: Upheld as a defect under Q11. The Cost column of the D-9 (part 2) row still says the other answer "changes the body of `showsPins` and its tests". No `showsPins` exists in src/ or tests/; the Decision column now names `forSessionStart`, and grep finds exactly one `showsPins` left in the file, on line 242. Because the rewrite fixed only half the row, the ADR states something false about the code. Fix: name `forSessionStart` in the Cost sentence as well.

Upheld as a defect under Q1 and Q5. The Design and ADR 0024 part 2 say the drain forgets a gone repository by `rebuildAll`'s own rule. That rule runs behind `scanRepos`, which calls `refuseLinkedRoots` before anything is forgotten. `refreshStale` (line 841) checks only that the knowledge root is not absent, and `refreshOne` (lines 805-809) forgets a repository's rows whenever `kindAt` of its path is "absent". Checked in repo.ts: `unseen` maps ENOTDIR to "not there". So when `knowledge/` is a file, `kindAt(root)` is "other", the check passes, every repository path reads as absent, and the unattended drain forgets every repository. When `knowledge/` or `knowledge/projects/` is a link, the drain decides presence through the link. In both states `knowledge rebuild` refuses and forgets nothing. Fix: call `refuseLinkedRoots` before the loop and treat a refusal as "forget nothing, log, return 0" (or put the forget step behind one guarded helper), and add refresh tests with `knowledge/` as a file and `knowledge/projects` as a link.
